chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Russ Morgan as a friend and in his own orchestra
summary: Morehouse says he and Morgan are close friends and he worked for him with Goldkette and later in Morgan's own orchestra without difference.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you remember that? A long time ago. 'Don't Blame Me'. Then Russ Morgan and his orchestra.
Russ Morgan and myself are very close friends.
Yup. In fact he wrote me a note.
It just had like this and over here he started and over here he let go.
You mean it ran off the end of the page?
Yeah. I like those kind of guys.
Do you remember his orchestra? Playing in it.
You had worked with him first when he was with the Goldkette group.
And then you came back and you worked with him again when he had his own orchestra.
Is there any difference in working with him from Goldkette to his own orchestra? Was he any different?
No, there is no difference. And I can say that truthfully.
